summary: Easy Metronome: Precise tempo for instrument practice and live music performance
description:
Easy Metronome is built for musicians of all levels. It helps you keep a steady tempo during practice or live performance. It’s precise, easy to use, and customizable to your preferences.

Music lessons feel simpler with a large visual beat display. Follow up to 16 beats, each with adjustable emphasis or silence. Enjoy precise tempo control—you can even tap the beat and let Easy Metronome follow your lead.

Teachers and experienced players can quickly select time signatures with a couple of taps and change subdivisions to explore different playing patterns.

For a tailored experience, choose from free beat sounds, or unlock additional choices—such as instrument and meditation sounds—with an optional in-app purchase. You can also personalize beat colors with themes, or match your wallpaper on Android 13+.

Group rehearsals run smoothly with the practice timer to control session length. It’s easy for everyone to follow on larger screens, with support for tablets and Chromebooks. Practicing solo? Easy Metronome is also available on your smartwatch with on-wrist control and our Wear OS tile.

Add widgets to keep time from the home screen, or adjust beat volume and balance for a monitor-style effect.

Our mission is to make keeping time simple and intuitive so you can focus on your music. We’re committed to thoughtful improvements while keeping the app straightforward to use.

Download Easy Metronome and enjoy precise rhythm.
